name: Bayline Loop Conversion API
note: Invented for this demo. Bayline Loop is a fictional partner-tracking platform.

signature.signedContent: The exact raw request body bytes

fields.name: event_id
fields.description: Unique ID for this event. Bayline Loop rejects a second event with the same ID (dedupe).

fields.name: event_type
fields.description: sale for a paid order, reversal when an order is refunded.

fields.name: click_id
fields.description: The Bayline Loop click ID captured when the shopper arrived from a partner link.

fields.name: order_id
fields.description: The store's order ID. A reversal uses the same order_id as its sale.

fields.name: amount
fields.description: Order total in the smallest currency unit (cents), so no rounding errors.

fields.name: currency
fields.description: Three-letter ISO-4217 currency code, upper case (for example USD).

fields.name: customer_status
fields.description: Whether this is the shopper's first order. Partners can earn more for new customers.

fields.name: promo_code
fields.description: Discount code used at checkout. Required when the store uses promo codes.

fields.name: occurred_at
fields.description: When the order was paid, as an ISO-8601 timestamp with a time zone.
